MRN: MRN-39890

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Elena Shaw, Family Health Partners

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of recurrent palpitations.

Diane Parker is a 62-year-old woman with atrial fibrillation, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. For the past two months, she has had intermittent episodes of a racing, irregular heartbeat lasting several minutes, both at rest and with activity. She reports occasional lightheadedness but no fainting or chest discomfort.

I would appreciate your evaluation of her recurrent palpitations and recommendations for further care.

Patient is on warfarin.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Elena Shaw
Family Health Partners
